scope: Synthetic pure-text development comparison; proposal-only; no Harness admission, domain commit, multimodal input, independent grader, or production adoption.

failure_audit.finding: Facts, minutes and prompt were correct, but the proposal invented a chart_questions entry although the source was not a chart and requested none. Both prompt variants returned an empty chart_questions list.
The applicable 20-minute rule was correct. start_time omitted the repeated date and the effective timestamp used ISO T; the task had not required one exact timestamp serialization.
The applicable 20-minute rule was correct. Only timestamp serialization differed from gold.
The applicable 20-minute rule was correct. Natural-language timestamp ordering differed from gold.
The proposal correctly labeled causality unsupported and asked what evidence would be needed before concluding causation. A substring rule misread this negated use as a causal claim.

limitations: The eight cases are newly authored development cases, not independent held-out certification.
The one audited baseline error is insufficient for a general quality claim.
Prompt variants changed instructions and observed outputs but did not execute a full domain admission/commit/read-back path.
The raw report remains local because it contains complete synthetic proposal text; the stable audit preserves counts, classifications, digests, and the local replay path.
